visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraved illustration depicting two men in formal attire walking through a dark, wooded area at night. The man in the foreground is wearing a fedora and a long coat, holding a leash attached to a large, low-slung animal, likely a dog, that is sniffing the ground. A second man follows closely behind him in the background. The style is reminiscent of late 19th or early 20th-century book illustrations.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Two men, a dog, a leash, trees, forest floor, shadows.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: Two adult men dressed in period-appropriate suits and hats.
visualDescription.uncertaintyNotes: The exact breed of the animal is difficult to determine due to the dark, high-contrast nature of the engraving, though it appears to be a large dog. The specific historical context or source of the illustration is not identified.

suggestedMatch.exactSourceQuotation: Holmes then threw the handkerchief to a distance, fastened a stout cord to the mongrel’s collar, and led him to the foot of the water-barrel. The creature instantly broke into a succession of high, tremulous yelps, and, with his nose on the ground, and his tail in the air, pattered off upon the trail at a pace which strained his leash and kept us at the top of our speed.
